product.name: Monoprice Blackbird 4K60 4x4 Video Matrix Switcher with HDMI Supports HDR HDCP 2.2 18Gbps YCbCr 444
product.description: This 4K 4x4 HDMI® Matrix allows you to distribute any of up to four HDMI video sources to any or all of up to four displays. It complies with the HDMI 2.0 and HDCP™ 2.2 specifications, delivers up to 18Gbps video bandwidth, and supports video resolutions up to 4K@60Hz with the YCbCr 4:4:4 color space, including all HDMI 3D video modes. Each output can be individually downscaled to 1080p and each output has a digital coaxial and stereo analog audio output for connecting an external amplifier or powered speakers. It supports the Audio Return Channel (ARC) HDMI feature, which allows audio from the display to be redirected to the digital coaxial output.
